address_comment: ARM32 addresses only, serializing with the guest address space
wait_wake: Runtime/Bionic/agr_futex_host.h keys wait and wake by a uint32_t address and does not return a Darwin pointer
runtime_binding: Runtime/NativeCore/agr_runtime.c installs that binding on Apple and reads guest memory
closure_probe: The CROSSING_CLOSED probe ran the same state machine through a test callback table. That probe does not add a HOST-DEX storage clause to the crossing record.
host_services: agr_host_services exports no wait or wake function. The migration-plan ledger line is not an implemented contract.
